description: This file defines a Flutter provider class MedicalRecordsProvider that manages fetching and creating medical records via an API client. It maintains loading state and record items, offers methods for external widgets to interact with the medical records data, and incorporates change notifications.

classes.name: MedicalRecordsProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier-based provider class that handles fetching and creating medical records, maintaining internal state and notifying listeners upon changes.

methods.name: MedicalRecordsProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing the provider with an ApiClient instance.

methods.name: isLoading
methods.description: Getter that indicates whether a fetch or create operation is currently ongoing.

methods.name: items
methods.description: Getter that provides an unmodifiable list of the fetched medical records.

methods.name: _setLoading
methods.description: Private method to update the loading state and notify listeners.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches medical records from the API, optionally filtered by patientId, and updates the internal items list.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new medical record for a specified patient, optionally with entries, and refreshes the records list upon success.
